correctness.rationale: PASS: On the invariant line f(x)=-mx-1 on [-1,0], f(x)=x-1 on [0,m-1], finite entry holds for every finite planar state. First returns to J0 have exactly m full branches x↦-mx-r, return times r with uniform Lebesgue weights; Kac and Abramov give cell densities 2(m-j)/(m(m+1)) and entropy 2log(m)/(m+1). Markov transfer/Perron root beta_m solves sum beta^-r=1; relative entropy H(q)≤log(beta) sum r q_r uniquely selects q_r=beta^-r. Dominated convergence yields physical triangular macroscopic density, MME tight fixed-index geometric law and beta_m→2. Independent exact branch and cell balance tests on 33 m values corroborate, not prove, all m. Endpoint orbits are measure-zero exceptions; h_top refers only to compact I_m.
